key_provisions_or_claims: Sets airworthiness design, construction and verification requirements for lightweight fixed-wing UAS.
Defines a UAS to include aircraft, control station, C2 links, launch/recovery equipment and crew.
Intended to support CAA, self- or third-party airworthiness determinations and risk-based operational approvals.
Covers flight, performance, structure, command and control, documentation and verification requirements.
Developed under WTO TBT principles for international standards.
annotation.summary_en: ASTM F3298-19 store page for a voluntary standard specifying airworthiness design, construction and verification requirements for lightweight fixed-wing unmanned aircraft systems, supporting civil aviation authority approvals or self/third-party airworthiness determinations using risk-based categories.
